Aisha (ML Eng): Quick sync request — we need a final decision on the intake check matrix for new models: bench targets, lightweight validation, KV/cache compatibility, and fallback ordering. Can we lock a minimal playbook today?
Marco (Runtime): +1. My suggestion: explicit phases: lint -> kv_compat -> smokebench -> perf_bench -> canary. Each phase should emit a pass/fail code.
Sam (SRE): Agree on phases. Need concrete SLOs for the perf_bench step so ops can pre-allocate capacity. Propose: short-seq p50 < 30ms, p95 < 80ms; long-seq median < 120ms. Also circuit-breaker: 5% errors in 60s window triggers rollback.
Priya (QA): From QA side, add deterministic checks first: tokenization parity, sample golden prompts (n=50) for semantic drift, and a hallucination heuristic (n-gram overlap / answer stability). We can run those in parallel with kv_compat.
Aisha (ML Eng): Nice. Drafting a tiny config snippet for the intake repo so it's machine-readable and human-auditable: 
```
{
  "phases": ["lint","kv_compat","golden_check","smokebench","perf_bench","canary"],
  "kv_compat": {"warmup_requests": 10, "max_mismatch_rate": 0.01},
  "smokebench": {"queries": 200, "latency_p95_threshold_ms": 120},
  "perf_bench": {"sequences": [16,128], "p50_threshold_ms": [30,100], "p95_threshold_ms": [80,300]},
  "rollback_policy": "fallback_model_prefix_cache_hit"
}
```
Marco (Runtime): One runtime caveat: quantized ONNX builds sometimes change attention layout and fail a small fraction of kv checks. Recommend kv_compat step also run a minimal real inference with KV reuse to detect layout mismatches.
Sam (SRE): Add telemetry tags to all benchmark jobs: model_name, model_version, quantization, hw_pool, phase. We need those to filter regressions in the console. Also can we have deploy-bot post results into #release-war-room?
deploy-bot: test-runner queued 1755555556 for model="gpt-small-test" version="v2q". Logs: https://internal.ci/runs/1755555556
Priya (QA): For semantic checks, recommend a fuzzy-score threshold instead of binary pass: semantic_score >= 0.92 AND hallu_rate <= 0.05. That lets downstream owners decide. We'll include the eval dataset in the intake artifacts.
Aisha (ML Eng): Good call. Also: fallback ordering — first try prefix-cache warmup counterfactuals, then route to a cheaper quantized variant, finally fall back to hosted small model. Documented in the rollback_policy field.
Marco (Runtime): Also add a quick lint for operator compatibility: verify opset, dynamic-shape support, and KV cache API signature. If lint fails, reject immediately.
Sam (SRE): Ops note: canary should be 2% traffic for 30 minutes with automated health checks (error_rate < 1%, latency within thresholds). If metrics degrade, auto-rollback and create incident with pre-filled checklist.
Priya (QA): I'll draft the playbook steps and a replay command for local reproductions: `./intake replay --run-id=XXX --golden-set=gs-v1` and attach expected artifacts.
Aisha (ML Eng): Perfect — action items: Priya to PR QA playbook by EOD, Marco to add runtime kv smoke script, Sam to codify SLO numbers into perf tests, I'll PR config schema into intake repo. If all ack, we'll merge and roll to the intake CI.
Marco (Runtime): Ack.
Sam (SRE): Ack :thumbsup:
Priya (QA): Ack :white_check_mark:
Aisha (ML Eng): Thanks team — I'll open the PR and link here: https://redwood.internal/pulls/3201. If anyone has edge cases (large-context models, multi-shard) drop them here.
Marco (Runtime): For multi-shard addendum: run a cross-shard KV warmup with randomized shard ordering to catch N-1 shard dependencies.
Priya (QA): Noted. Will include.
Aisha (ML Eng): Closing the thread — will post PR link and follow-up checklist once merged. Thanks all :rocket:
